author: ETA PRIME
description:
CD Projekt Red just dropped the free remastered update for The Witcher 3, bringing overhauled lighting, enhanced textures, and a reimagined skill system to Steam. We are putting this next-gen upgrade to the ultimate test on a Steam Machine powered by an RDNA 3 GPU featuring 28 compute units and 8GB of VRAM.   In this benchmark, we test Ultra settings across 1080p, 1440p, and 4K resolutions to see exactly what this compact machine can handle. Watch as we tweak AMD's FSR and Frame Generation to rescue native 4K framerates from an unplayable 14 FPS to a much smoother experience. We also discuss why Ray Tracing currently has to remain disabled due to GPU crashing on SteamOS, and we take a look at Valve quietly removing their 4K performance claims from the official Steam Machine website.

author: ETA PRIME
description: hands-on look at the all-new Lenovo Legion Cloud Gaming Handheld Console C700! Officially marketed as a cloud streaming device, this ultra-thin handheld actually packs enough power to handle native Android gaming and high-end emulation. We test out the 7.82" 120Hz IPS display, TMR analog sticks, and the MediaTek Dimensity 7400 processor.
title: Legion C700 gaming handheld First look
